problem_type: Typecheck selection prefilters real program roots with an independent extension list
symptom: An allowJs CJS root is compiled by tsc but changing it alone does not select typecheck; the real-root probe fails.
direct_cause: touchesTypecheck discards JS, JSX, MJS and CJS before querying typecheckCoveredFiles.
class_root: The selector duplicates compiler coverage with a handwritten candidate list instead of using the actual program-root set as the only source-file authority.
affected_population: Every allowJs program in TYPECHECK_PROJECTS, including future JS roots
entry_points: Pre-push selectGates and SCAN_TESTS typecheck condition share touchesGateInputs
internal_only_reason: This is an internal selector invariant; installed TypeScript parseJsonConfigFileContent is exercised directly, with no external API or dependency change.
invariants: Every actual program root selects typecheck regardless of suffix
Uncovered scripts do not select typecheck unless they are existing explicit config, side-input or implementation dependencies

door_reduction.why_not: The dispatcher and compiler-derived membership query remain separate read responsibilities. The additional regression-test door exercises the shared boundary directly with isolated tsconfigs; it is not a second production selector. The duplicated extension authority is deleted.

generality_proof: Removing the extension prefilter lets every root returned by TypeScript reach set membership, across all configured programs and supported source shapes. Nonmembers remain unselected. Existing config and side-input triggers are preserved; the wrapper continues handling implementation dependencies.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Select actual roots by compiler-derived membership without a second source-extension authority.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The sole production caller delegates normalized files to touchesTypecheck, including allowJs roots.
The typecheck gate calls touchesGateInputs; selectGates uses the same shared boundary.
These extensions declare source scans for other guards; the derived typecheck branch returns before this scanner logic.

recurrence.reason: Any current or future allowJs program can add a root omitted by the handwritten candidate regex. CJS exposed a class that also includes JS, JSX and MJS.
same_class_scan: door-map --read=touchesTypecheck --roots=src,electron,scripts,tests --include-tests: one production caller before regression additions
door-map --read=touchesGateInputs --roots=src,electron,scripts,tests --include-tests: three files, one production and two tests
rg touchesTypecheck/typecheckCoveredFiles/typecheck across scripts/pre-push*: no second typecheck source selector; SOURCE_EXTS belongs to unrelated scans

prevention.invariant: Only actual compiler coverage decides source membership; there is no extension prefilter.
prevention.failure_mode: Uncovered inputs return false; configuration-read errors still throw and block instead of silently claiming no coverage.
prevention.strategy: Delete the parallel candidate list and test actual TypeScript roots plus uncovered counterexamples.

legacy_paths.rationale: The handwritten extension prefilter is removed in place; no fallback or second selector survives.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency defect or upgrade: use the already installed TypeScript parser as the coverage authority.

migration: No stored data or caller signature changes; existing callers gain complete real-root selection.
residual_risks: Coverage continues to mean tsconfig root files, with the existing per-root process cache; imported non-root dependency tracking is outside this repair.
